name: Nadiya Peters
reason: Too thin once the rules are applied: her only current offering, the Kripalu programme (The Celts and the Tao, Apr 2027), is framed around liver health and improving memory, so it fails the health-claim rule; her own site (nadiyapeters.com, copyright 2018) lists no current classes or courses (the 'ongoing' Zoom class page dates from 2022 and promises immune boosting, past events include bone health and womb healing), she has no authored book on Amazon (only a contributed account in an anthology), and only two or three YouTube videos exist (one on her own 33-subscriber channel, a Tibet House talk and a J. Brown podcast). Email banriongealach108@gmail.com is published on her homepage and photos exist, so she could be revisited if she publishes current offerings.
